entities.name: James Henderson Blount
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: James Henderson Blount was an American politician, Confederate army soldier and congressman from Georgia. He opposed the annexation of Hawaii in 1893 in his investigation into the American involvement in the political revolution in the Kingdom of Hawai'i.
